PASSWORD_REQUIRED: User must have a password set
PASSWORD_FORBIDDEN: User must not have a password set
PASSWORD_RESET_PENDING: A password reset request is already pending
PASSWORD_SAME_AS_CURRENT: New password must be different from the current password
MFA_REGENERATION_RATE_LIMITED: MFA backup codes can only be regenerated once every 7 days
USER_EXTERNAL_REQUIRED: User must be an external account
EMAIL_NOT_VERIFIED: Account is not verified or has been suspended
OTP_SESSION_INVALID: OTP session is invalid or expired
SESSION_LOG_NOT_FOUND: No active session log was found for the current token
